name: Physical Therapy & Wellness
tagline: A gentle, restorative template for physical-therapy clinics — book evaluations online from day one.
description: A calm, whole-person physical-therapy site — a soft-sage palette, a warm-clay accent and a gentle serif display. Installs online booking from day one: evaluations and one-on-one sessions for pelvic health, balance, chronic pain and wellness, three therapists you book by name plus two private treatment rooms as resources, and reminder + evaluation-hold policies. Ships as "Restore Physical Therapy & Wellness".
